description: Copies the source object (whole trees included) into the destination when the source is fresh, or writes a constant when the source is unwired. Types and counts must match.

activation.text: Runs when the source is fresh, or on each pass an enable fires (an open gate, a tick). With no source it writes the constant when an enable fires, once at start when none is wired.

inputs.description: The object to copy. Leave it unwired to write the Value constant instead.
The object to write. Its type and element count must match the source exactly; there is no conversion.

fields.description: The constant written to the first number of the destination while the source is unwired. It is converted to the destination's type: rounded, saturated.
